name: houdini-mcp
description: Connects Claude Code to the MCP server running inside Houdini and teaches the working rules, visual verification and scene debugging for the server and the base tool pack.

port.title: Houdini MCP port
port.description: Port of the MCP server inside Houdini (HOUDINI_MCP_PORT). Use a different port for a second Houdini instance.
